newsitem.title: MEXICO: Germany's Metro mulls Mexico move.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Metro mulls Mexico move.

text.p: Germany's retail giant Metro AG is mulling building 20 large-format supermarket stores in Mexico to tap the country's economic recovery and get a toehold in a hotly-contested emerging retail market.
Sources close to the company told Reuters the retailer could build the stores within a five year period.
"By September 1 the plans for the first store in Mexico City should be ready," said the source, who wished to remain anonymous. He added the store would open sometime next year.
The source did not know if the German retailer would seek a Mexican partner for its stores or go it alone.

Mexico has become an attractive retail market, with foreign firms like Wal-Mart Stores Inc. linking up with Mexican partners like Cifra and France's Auchan building hypermarket format stores on its own.
